# Code pipelines

The commands `mt help` lists under Code pipelines. More in [Code pipelines](../../../concepts/code-pipelines.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`code-pipeline-answer`](#code-pipeline-answer) | Answer a question a code pipeline run is waiting on |
| [`code-pipeline-attach`](#code-pipeline-attach) | Follow a code pipeline run until it ends: status, phases, steps and questions as they happen (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed) |
| [`code-pipeline-delete`](#code-pipeline-delete) | Delete a code pipeline (refused while it has live runs or an automation starts it) |
| [`code-pipeline-diff`](#code-pipeline-diff) | Show what a code pipeline run changed: the files, or the unified diff with `--raw` |
| [`code-pipeline-get`](#code-pipeline-get) | Show a code pipeline by name or `--id`, with the phases, steps and inputs of its latest version |
| [`code-pipeline-history`](#code-pipeline-history) | List code pipeline runs, live and ended, newest first (of one code pipeline when named, else of the namespace; every namespace with `--all`) |
| [`code-pipeline-kill`](#code-pipeline-kill) | Stop a live code pipeline run (it ends as Killed, and code-pipeline-resume can carry it on) |
| [`code-pipeline-list`](#code-pipeline-list) | List the code pipelines in a namespace, or in every namespace with `--all` |
| [`code-pipeline-payloads`](#code-pipeline-payloads) | Show chosen transcript entries of a code pipeline run in full, by id (tool calls and what its agents wrote) |
| [`code-pipeline-process-get`](#code-pipeline-process-get) | Show a code pipeline run: its status, every phase and step, and any question it is waiting on |
| [`code-pipeline-ps`](#code-pipeline-ps) | List the live code pipeline runs in a namespace, or in every namespace with `--all` |
| [`code-pipeline-restart`](#code-pipeline-restart) | Start an ended code pipeline run over, as a new run with the same version, inputs, repositories and credentials |
| [`code-pipeline-resume`](#code-pipeline-resume) | Resume a code pipeline run that ended in Error or was Killed, from the step it stopped at |
| [`code-pipeline-resume-with-prompt`](#code-pipeline-resume-with-prompt) | Resume a code pipeline run that ended in Error or was Killed, with a prompt for the interrupted step's agent |
| [`code-pipeline-run`](#code-pipeline-run) | Run a code pipeline and follow it until it ends: status, phases, steps and questions as they happen (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed) |
| [`code-pipeline-start`](#code-pipeline-start) | Start a run of a code pipeline's latest version (inputs as `--input-<name>`; repositories and credentials from a request file) |
| [`code-pipeline-step-payloads`](#code-pipeline-step-payloads) | Show one step's transcript of a code pipeline run: its tool calls and its agent's text, in order |
| [`code-pipeline-update-credentials`](#code-pipeline-update-credentials) | Replace the AI credentials a live code pipeline run uses, from a local JSON file (the run carries on) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`code-pipeline-update-repos`](#code-pipeline-update-repos) | Replace a live code pipeline run's repositories and their git credentials, from a local JSON file (the run carries on) *(not in the cloud shell)* |

## code-pipeline-answer

Answer a question a code pipeline run is waiting on.

```text
mt code-pipeline-answer <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The code pipeline run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--answer, -a <value>` | text | yes |  | Your answer to the question |
| `--request-id, -r <id>` | id |  |  | The question's request id (from code-pipeline-process-get; not needed when only one question is waiting) |

## code-pipeline-attach

Follow a code pipeline run until it ends: status, phases, steps and questions as they happen (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed).

```text
mt code-pipeline-attach <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The code pipeline run's id |

## code-pipeline-delete

Delete a code pipeline (refused while it has live runs or an automation starts it).

```text
mt code-pipeline-delete [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text |  |  | Name of the code pipeline, or name@namespace (or give `--id` instead) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--id, -i <id>` | id |  |  | The code pipeline's id, instead of its name |
| `--confirm` | flag |  |  | Delete it; without this the command only shows what would be deleted |

## code-pipeline-diff

Show what a code pipeline run changed: the files, or the unified diff with `--raw`.

```text
mt code-pipeline-diff <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The code pipeline run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--raw` | flag |  |  | Print the unified diff instead of the list of changed files |

## code-pipeline-get

Show a code pipeline by name or `--id`, with the phases, steps and inputs of its latest version.

```text
mt code-pipeline-get [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text |  |  | The code pipeline's name, or name@namespace (or give `--id`) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--id, -i <id>` | id |  |  | The code pipeline's id, instead of its name |

## code-pipeline-history

List code pipeline runs, live and ended, newest first (of one code pipeline when named, else of the namespace; every namespace with `--all`).

```text
mt code-pipeline-history [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text |  |  | Only runs of this code pipeline: its name, or name@namespace |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--all, -a` | flag |  |  | List the runs of every namespace (ignored when a name is given) |
| `--state, -s <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs in this state: active (queued or running), waiting (on a person, an approval or a resume) or terminal (ended) |
| `--limit, -l <number>` | whole number |  | `20` | Maximum number of runs to list (1-200) |
| `--cursor <value>` | text |  |  | The cursor a previous page printed, for the next page |

## code-pipeline-resume

Resume a code pipeline run that ended in Error or was Killed, from the step it stopped at.

```text
mt code-pipeline-resume <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The code pipeline run's id |

## code-pipeline-resume-with-prompt

Resume a code pipeline run that ended in Error or was Killed, with a prompt for the interrupted step's agent.

```text
mt code-pipeline-resume-with-prompt <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The code pipeline run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--prompt, -p <value>` | text | yes |  | What to tell the agent as it carries on |
| `--credentials-file <value>` | text |  |  | A local JSON file of the AI credentials to carry on with, as code-pipeline-update-credentials takes it (default: the run's own) |
| `--repos-file <value>` | text |  |  | A local JSON file of the repositories, with fresh git credentials, to carry on with, as code-pipeline-update-repos takes it (default: the run's own) |

## code-pipeline-run

Run a code pipeline and follow it until it ends: status, phases, steps and questions as they happen (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed).

```text
mt code-pipeline-run <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | The code pipeline's name |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--request-file, -f <value>` | text |  |  | A local JSON file with the rest of the start request (repos, credentials or credentialStack, agentOverrides, additionalSteps, vfsMounts...); read only from this computer's disk, as it may hold secrets |
| `--web-download-partition <value>` | text |  |  | A temporary knowledge base, by id or name, to keep the web pages the agents read (default: the namespace's, else the tenant's) |

Note: a pipeline's inputs are passed as `--input-<name>`: for an input called 'Work Item', pass `--input-work-item` &lt;value>. Inputs in the request file are used unless the same input is given on the command line.

## code-pipeline-start

Start a run of a code pipeline's latest version (inputs as `--input-<name>`; repositories and credentials from a request file).

```text
mt code-pipeline-start <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | The code pipeline's name |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--request-file, -f <value>` | text |  |  | A local JSON file with the rest of the start request (repos, credentials or credentialStack, agentOverrides, additionalSteps, vfsMounts...); read only from this computer's disk, as it may hold secrets |
| `--web-download-partition <value>` | text |  |  | A temporary knowledge base, by id or name, to keep the web pages the agents read (default: the namespace's, else the tenant's) |

Note: a pipeline's inputs are passed as `--input-<name>`: for an input called 'Work Item', pass `--input-work-item` &lt;value>. Inputs in the request file are used unless the same input is given on the command line.

## code-pipeline-step-payloads

Show one step's transcript of a code pipeline run: its tool calls and its agent's text, in order.

```text
mt code-pipeline-step-payloads <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The code pipeline run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--step, -s <id>` | id | yes |  | The step's id (the 'step id' column of code-pipeline-process-get) |
| `--full` | flag |  |  | Print every entry in full instead of a table of one-line previews |

## code-pipeline-update-credentials

Replace the AI credentials a live code pipeline run uses, from a local JSON file (the run carries on).

```text
mt code-pipeline-update-credentials <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The code pipeline run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--credentials-file, -f <value>` | text | yes |  | A local JSON file: an array of credentials, each {"type":"apiKey"\|"oauth", "engine":..., ...}, in failover order |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it reads AI credentials from a file on the local disk, and the cloud shell has none.

## code-pipeline-update-repos

Replace a live code pipeline run's repositories and their git credentials, from a local JSON file (the run carries on).

```text
mt code-pipeline-update-repos <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The code pipeline run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--repos-file, -f <value>` | text | yes |  | A local JSON file: an array of repositories, each {"type":"ssh"\|"http", "name":..., ...} with its credential |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it reads git credentials from a file on the local disk, and the cloud shell has none.
